promotions.reason: "Dices" is non-standard English. "Dice" is the correct word in modern English (both singular and plural). Tabler already uses "dice". No family members to rename.

no_further_promotions: flame — "fire" is in aliases and Heroicons uses it, but Lucide/Phosphor/Tabler all use "flame"; no consensus to override
funnel — "filter" is the concept but collides with list-filter; "funnel" is the glyph and used by 3/5 libraries
paperclip — "attach" is the concept but "paperclip" is universal across icon libraries
pencil — "edit" is the concept (Material uses it) but "pencil" is the de facto standard name across all icon libraries
trash — "delete" is the concept but collides with Lucide's "delete" (backspace glyph); collision risk too high
scan-face — "face-id" (Tabler) is Apple-branded terminology; "scan-face" is more generic
sliders-horizontal — "adjustments" (Heroicons/Tabler) is not clearly better than the Lucide/Phosphor name
party-popper — "celebration" (Material) or "confetti" (Phosphor/Tabler) have no consensus; glyph name is fine
meh — informal but short and expressive; no better universal alternative
life-buoy — hyphenated form is consistent with Lucide naming conventions
cross — could be "medical" but the geometric name is valid and non-confusing
a-large-small — awkward but no better universal name; "font-size" is in aliases
text-cursor-input — verbose but specific enough to avoid collision
circle-dollar-sign — could be "coin" but would confuse with plural "coins" icon
monitor-smartphone — "responsive" is a CSS concept, not an icon concept
globe-lock — "vpn" is too jargon-heavy for a general icon name
check-check — slightly awkward but consistent with Lucide; "double-check" in aliases
badge-check — "verified" is the concept but badge is a 3-member family; can't promote one member
copy-check — follows the established {action}-check pattern (bookmark-check, file-check, etc.)
messages-square — follows message-square pluralization pattern; "forum" would break convention
radio-tower — no clearly better alternative among "broadcast-tower", "antenna", etc.
server-crash — "server-error" is not clearly better; "crash" is well-understood
droplet — used for color picking but glyph is a water drop; no clean conceptual name
sticky-note — universally understood compound name
scroll-text — descriptive and accurate
braces — precise glyph description for {}; "code-block" or "json" are too specific
